name: Tacos AlPastor Spring Valley
notes: 4 photos: photo 1 is the main exterior board (burritos/tacos/quesatacos/breakfast burritos/rolled tacos/fries/nachos/specialties/quesadillas), used as the primary source. Photo 2 is a second indoor board with additional combo/specialty items (Surf & Turf, seafood burritos, combination plates, flautas, churros); duplicate item names shared with photo 1 were not re-added, and a partly-obscured 'Veggie' burrito with no visible price was skipped. Photo 3 shows the same category set as photo 1 at different (apparently updated) prices, treated as a duplicate menu rather than re-added. Photo 4 was too blurry to read. Tacos/quesatacos list a maiz and harina price; the maiz (lower) price was used.
